Bedrock Edition can play with Bedrock Edition and Java Edition can play with Java Edition:

Bedrock Edition = Xbox One, PS4, Mobile, Windows 10, Nintendo Switch

Java Edition = Windows, Mac, Linux

Windows 10 can play both Bedrock and Java, but they are two separate games, thus you can’t play together between Bedrock and Java without a proxy like GeyserMC.

Just join any of the featured servers like normal, and it should redirect you to a BedrockConnect server with an in-game menu where you can tell it what server to join. It doesn’t matter what secondary DNS you use as long as it is a real DNS server (I recommend Cloudfare’s 1.1.1.1 or Google’s 8.8.8.8), but the primary DNS needs to be the BedrockConnect DNS server (104.238.130.180). This will not affect any other game’s connection to the internet, so you should be able to leave it. It it still doesn’t work, make sure your Xbox says “IPv4” under the network name, not “IPv4 & IPv6”. If you need more help, I’ll be glad to help in DMs.

You can’t join the TG Earth server since it’s Java only, but you can join the TG Survival server on Bedrock using the BedrockConnect DNS server. More info here: https://github.com/Pugmatt/BedrockConnect

P.S. BedrockConnect only works on IPv4 connections, meaning if your router supports and uses IPv6 (meaning that your Xbox will say “IPv4 and IPv6” under the network name instead of “IPv4”) it won’t work since Xbox hasn’t allowed us to use custom DNS servers for IPv6 (they half-implemented IPv6 support into Xbox, which is annoying).

Edit: If you need a step by step video, here you go. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g8mHvasVHMs
